title: Former Syracuse basketball star owes city $500K for violations at downtown building
summary: A former Syracuse University basketball player (2003 national championship captain) faces a $500,000 judgment from the City of Syracuse for code violations at a downtown building purchased five years ago. This represents a code enforcement action with potential implications for downtown property accountability and building standards compliance.
